name: closing-call-to-action
purpose: The last ask at the end of a landing page, followed by a hatched closing frame with no rules of its own, because the site footer under it opens with one. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'closing-call-to-action', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `call-to-action`, `button`, `registration-frame` and `texture`. `variant` picks the layout only: `split` sets the headline and the primary action in a raised lead cell beside an aside cell carrying the description and the secondary action, over a tall closing frame; `panel` sets the copy and its actions on one surface, over a short closing frame; `primary` is the loud close, one centred ask on the canvas under a pixelated texture whose waves keep travelling, over a tall closing frame. All three take the same copy, the same two actions and an optional copyable shell `command` set before the actions. `frame` draws the closing frame alone, with no ask: the close of a page whose last band already carries its own action. `hatch` turns the closing frame off when another closing band stacks directly below and draws the shared one (`site-page` sets it for stacked closings). In `primary`, `audiences` turns the ask into a switch between ways in (a person or an agent): each audience swaps in its own copyable line and actions, and a typed line (`typedLead` + `typedWords`) loops under them; the switch block loads on demand, only when `audiences` is set.
useWhen: Use ClosingCallToAction for the last band before the site footer that asks for one action, with links or a command.
Rendering page JSON, or you need a whole band with no custom content → this section. Building an SFC by hand, needing slots, or nesting inside another band → the `call-to-action` primitive.
In `primary` with `audiences`, to close a page whose reader may be a person or an agent, each with its own way in.
To close a solution or product page on its one or two asks (`split`), or a page such as Careers on one action (`panel`), or a page that ends on its one loud ask (`primary`).
avoidWhen: For a newsletter sign-up close → use `newsletter-section`.
For a close that lists deployable templates → use `template-gallery` with `closing`.
For an ask in the middle of a page → compose `call-to-action` directly.
related: call-to-action` — the framed band this section renders.
newsletter-section` — the closing band whose ask is a subscribe form.
template-gallery` — with `closing`, the closing band that lists deployable templates.
bestPractices: Place it last on the page, right above `site-footer`, after a hatched `section-gap`. It draws the hatched closing frame itself, so nothing follows it inside the page column: no trailing `SectionGap` and no closing `RegistrationFrame` + `Texture` (the `shell/site` close is for a page that ends on any other band). `webkit/no-gap-after-closing-section` flags the doubled close.
Set `anchor: 'contact'` so the page's contact links scroll to the close.
Use `variant: 'frame'` (no copy) to close a page that ends on a band with its own actions (a listing, a legal page); `site-page` draws no gap before it.
Turn `hatch` off only on a closing band that another closing band follows directly; the last one keeps the frame.
Give `command` a short shell line (`npm create azion@latest`); it is copied as written and reads as a command, with the `$` prompt.

Give `audiences` two or more entries so the switch renders; set `audiencesAriaLabel` and `lineAriaLabel` so the switch and the copyable field are named. With `audiences` set, `description` is the closing sentence under the typed line, and `command` and the two actions are not drawn.
Mark a command line with `copy.shell` so it draws the `$` prompt; leave a prompt meant for an agent bare.
In `split`, keep `title` and `titleMuted` to one short line each; `panel` and `primary` do not draw `titleMuted`, and `primary` does not draw `eyebrow`.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Layout of the band: `split` is a raised lead cell beside an aside cell over a tall closing frame, `panel` one surface over a short closing frame, `primary` a centred ask under a pixelated texture over a tall closing frame, `frame` the tall closing frame alone.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a `#hash` link can scroll to it.

props.name: eyebrow
props.doc: Short overline above the headline; not drawn in `primary`.

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline of the band, rendered by the call to action as its `h2`; the band renders nothing when empty.

props.name: titleMuted
props.doc: Second line of the headline in muted ink; drawn in `split` only.

props.name: description
props.doc: Supporting sentence: in the aside cell in `split`, under the headline in `panel`.

props.name: primaryAction
props.doc: The white button of the band, under the headline in `split`; `{ label, href, trailing? }` where `trailing` adds the chevron. Omitted when absent.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.doc: The outlined button of the band, in the aside cell in `split` and beside the primary one in `panel` and `primary`; `{ label, href, trailing? }`. Omitted when absent.

props.name: command
props.doc: Shell command on a copyable line before the actions, copied as written; drawn in `split`, `panel` and `primary`.

props.name: hatch
props.doc: Draws the hatched closing frame under the band; turn it off when another closing band stacks directly below and draws the shared frame.

props.name: audiences
props.doc: The ways in of the `primary` close, in switch order; each is `{ value, label, copy?, actions? }` (`copy` is `{ label, text, shell? }`, `shell` drawing the `$` prompt; an action is `{ label, href, variant?, trailing? }`) and the first one opens. Replaces the command and the two actions; the switch renders only with two or more.

props.name: typedLead
props.doc: Fixed opening of the typed line under the audiences, before the typed word.

props.name: typedWords
props.doc: Words typed, held, erased and typed again in order after `typedLead`; the typed line renders only with `audiences` and words.

props.name: audiencesAriaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the audience switch.

props.name: lineAriaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the read-only field that shows an audience's copyable line.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import ClosingCallToAction from '@aziontech/webkit/closing-call-to-action'

  const primaryAction = {
    label: 'Start for free',
    href: 'https://console.azion.com/signup?tck=build_cta'
  }

  const secondaryAction = {
    label: 'Talk to a specialist',
    href: 'https://www.azion.com/en/contact/',
    trailing: true
  }
</script>

<template>
  <ClosingCallToAction
    variant="split"
    anchor="contact"
    eyebrow="Build"
    title="Build once."
    title-muted="Run everywhere."
    description="Get a faster path to launch, lower latency, and less infrastructure overhead."
    :primary-action="primaryAction"
    :secondary-action="secondaryAction"
  />
</template>

examples.name: Variants
Command
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import ClosingCallToAction from '@aziontech/webkit/closing-call-to-action'
  import SectionContainer from '@aziontech/webkit/section-container'
  import SectionGap from '@aziontech/webkit/section-gap'
</script>

<template>
  <SectionContainer max-width="site">
    <SectionGap hatch />

    <ClosingCallToAction
      variant="primary"
      anchor="contact"
      title="Start your first project from the terminal."
      description="One command scaffolds a project and deploys it to every data center."
      command="npm create azion@latest"
      :primary-action="{ label: 'Start for free', href: '/signup' }"
      :secondary-action="{ label: 'Docs', href: '/docs', trailing: true }"
    />
  </SectionContainer>
</template>
